messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: unmarked version 0.8-7
parts:
Hello everyone,

I just submitted version 0.8-7 of unmarked to CRAN. It will probably
take a few days before it is available, but once it is, you can
download it from within R by typing install.packages("unmarked").
There are many minor changes in this version that can be browsed at
www.github.com/rbchan/unmarked. The one major change is the addition
of a new function called gmultmix that fits a general
multinomial-mixture model to data collected during primary and
secondary sampling periods. This allows you to estimate abundance
while accounting for the probability that an individual will be
available for detection, and the probability of detection given
availability. Each of these three parameters can be modeled as linear
functions of covariates. The backbone of this function was provided by
Andy Royle who is now a co-developer. See the help page for more
details.

Ian Fiske who deserves most of the credit for developing this package
has unfortunately gotten a job. I suppose it's a good thing for him
but we will miss his help. Until he is able to return to the project,
I will be maintaining it. As always, send questions and bug reports to
the list.

Richard
